content.title: Waste Hauling History
content.summary: The City of Arvada implemented an Organized Waste Hauling program on July 5, 2021, following City Council approval of the related ordinance on June 15, 2020. The initiative aims to create a more efficient, safer, and cost-effective waste management system, responding to community feedback indicating strong support for organized waste hauling. The program is expected to reduce the number of trucks on the road, lower costs for residents, and enhance recycling and customer service options.
content.body:
This page contains a record of the City's Organized Waste Hauling program. City Council approved the related ordinance and agreements to institute the system at the June 15, 2020 business meeting. The City team implemented this program on July 5, 2021. Certain details may change as the program is developed.

At its June 15, 2020 business meeting, the Arvada City Council held a public hearing and approved the related ordinance and agreements to institute the system by a vote of 4 to 3. The program began with a partnership with Republic Services on July 5, 2021.

## Project Background

Arvada residents have consistently indicated that an efficient, organized waste hauling system is extremely important to them (85% in the 2015 community survey and two-thirds in the [2017 and 2019 Community surveys](/238/Community-Survey). In response to results from the Arvada Community Surveys and recommendations from the City's Sustainability Advisory Committee, the City of Arvada began exploring organized waste hauling in our community. The program is anticipated to identify options that would be safer, cleaner and less expensive for the community by:

- Creating fewer trucks on the road (and less often) for:
  - Increased safety
  - Reduced road damage
  - Decreased noise and air pollution
- Reducing costs to residents
- Increasing recycling options
- Increasing quality of customer service

1. [Implementation Timeline](#tabd823e112-6417-4c30-a7d1-cd609272ea45_0)

- **Council workshop December 10, 2018**: Arvada's resident-led Sustainability Advisory Committee presented their recommendations to Council for an organized waste hauling system.
  - [Council Workshop December 10, 2018 Presentation (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/1026)
  - View the [December 10, 2018 Workshop Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-EcZordQZh4)
- **Council workshop February 11, 2019**: Staff presented to Council; Council permitted residents' questions; Staff generated an FAQ page in response
  - [Council Workshop February 11, 2019 Presentation (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/1021)
  - View the [February 11, 2019 Workshop Video](https://youtu.be/4dO9Ir05jPs)
  - [Council Workshop February 11, 2019 Meeting Minutes (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/1027)
- **Council workshop May 13, 2019**: Staff presented results of the Speak Up Arvada survey and other information to Council
  - [Council Workshop May 13, 2019 Presentation (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/1022)
  - View the [May 13, 2019 Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aEpZqyhrupA&t=1s)
- **May 2019:**Staff released a Request for Proposal (RFP) to waste hauling companies
  - [Request for Proposal (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/1023)
- **Council workshop July 22, 2019**: Staff presented a summary of the RFP information received from waste hauling companies
  - [Council Workshop July 22, 2019 Presentation (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/1024)
  - View the [July 22, 2019 Meeting Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qaQ516oe4gU&feature=youtu.be)
- **Council business meeting May 4, 2020**: City Council heard a first reading on a proposed ordinance to allow an organized waste hauling system in Arvada.
  - Download the[Proposed Organized Waste Hauling Ordinance (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/1025)
- **Council workshop May 11, 2020**: City Council further discussed the project.
  - View the [May 11, 2020 Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAVOgVQM76k).
- **Public Forum**May 28, 2020:
  - View the [May 28, 2020 Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=306&v=_LCznAQCpws&feature=emb_logo)
- **Council business meeting / public hearing June 15, 2020**. Council approved ordinance and agreement to move forward with an organized system.
  - View the [June 15, 2020 Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UN0WuTpjK84&feature=emb_logo)

1. [Public Engagement](#tabd823e112-6417-4c30-a7d1-cd609272ea45_1)

- **May 2020:**Speak Up Arvada, Public Forum, In-Person "office hours" appointments
- **March through May 2019:** Public survey posted on Speak Up Arvada to help refine the Request for Proposal (RFP) scope
- **February 2019:** Council invited the public to share their questions regarding organized waste hauling in Arvada at their February 11 council workshop. All questions were compiled.
- **February 2019:** FAQ document generated from residents' questions; posted on arvada.org and on Speak Up Arvada.
